productDefinition.primaryUser: Any authenticated tenant user holding APP.HCM and an active HRIS access package with HRIS_DUTY_APP_SHELL_READER
productDefinition.primaryQuestion: Which HRIS work can I open now, and which authorized work should I resume?
productDefinition.primaryAction: Search an authorized HRIS destination, open it, or resume an authorized in-progress item

navigation.sidebarRule: The existing seven workbenches remain unchanged. Explorer is reachable from an exact-authorized utility action and is never added as an eighth workbench.
navigation.homeRule: Home may expose one secondary Work Explorer action only after the exact explorer PAGE route is allowed. The 76-node HrisProductMap is not mounted on Home or Explorer.

centralAuthorization.surfaceDecision: A dedicated product-wide utility surface is used because hcm.personal, hcm.team, hcm.operations and hcm.management are persona/workbench ownership boundaries and none represents ANY_AUTHORIZED_DESCENDANT.

receiptQuery.rule: This additional exact profile admits only an explorer receipt whose sealed subject is the authenticated principal and whose originatingAction is EXPLORER_PREFERENCES_REPLACE or EXPLORER_RECENT_RECORD. It does not grant access to configuration, integration or any other HRIS command receipt.

predicates.meaning: Require verified tenant and principal, APP.HCM, the exact shell-reader package/duty relation, current authorization and field-policy revisions, and at least one currently allowed descendant PAGE route. For explorer receipt reads also prove the sealed explorer originating action, subject and request context.

Preserve PEP-SYS-040 for configuration and integration readers by proving the sealed originating command action, subject, population, field, purpose and current more-restrictive authorization context.

generatorResponsibilityMapping.rule: The generator's closed required-responsibility mapping must add this exact pair with a dedicated negative test; it must not allow arbitrary HRIS_DUTY_* values.

pepSuccessorAmendment.reason: The recovered PEP explorer rows list only HRIS_EMPLOYEE while HRIS-NAV-EXPLORE, the IA home row and the atomic duty matrix define the product-wide utility for five HRIS packages. This successor explicitly resolves that conflict in favor of the five-package shell-reader matrix.

receiptProfiles.preserved: platform-originating-command-receipt-reader for HRIS_CONFIG_AUTHOR, HRIS_CONFIG_PUBLISHER, HRIS_INTEGRATION_AUTHOR and HRIS_INTEGRATION_EXECUTOR with hcm.command-receipt.view
receiptProfiles.added: explorer-originating-receipt-reader for the five shell-reader packages with hcm.app.shell.view

catalog.stableRouteKeyRule: hris.explorer.<sourceNodeKey with every dot replaced by hyphen>
catalog.labelKeyRule: hris.explorer.routes.<sourceNodeKey with every dot replaced by hyphen>
catalog.labelRule: Every one of the 98 stable label keys must have explicit ko and en values. Missing labels fail generation; source keys are never shown to users.

authorizationProjection.rule: The response carries the exact current product-authorization PAGE decision that admitted the node. Raw IA capability references and client-side role lists are never treated as runtime authority.
authorizationProjection.unmappedOrUnavailableRule: Omit the node. A planned or historical IA lifecycle value never activates it.

targets.internalRule: HRIS_INTERNAL targets must match ^/hr(?:/|$) and must resolve to an exact allowed HCM PAGE route.
targets.dwpControlRule: DWP_CONTROL is limited to the six literal targets below and is emitted only when that exact shared PAGE route is deployed and allowed. No prefix or generic /admin allowlist exists.
targets.inactiveExternalRule: The other five targets remain absent until their own exact shared PAGE contracts are delivered.

transportAmendment.supersedesOnly: The Explorer projection portions of the recovered G2 schema; the recovered evidence file remains immutable.
transportAmendment.projectionRule: ExplorerRouteProjection, ExplorerFavoriteProjection and ExplorerRecentProjection all reuse the same closed ExplorerRouteIdentityV2 target and authorization schema; no projection retains the old /hr-only path or scalar capabilityKey.
responseChanges: Add nullable nextCursor so limit and cursor form a complete keyset contract.
Add projectionStatus FRESH|STALE|PARTIAL and closed degradedSource summaries.
Never serialize tenant identity, role lists, source payloads, worker identifiers or case bodies.

writeContract.favorites: At most 20 unique ordered authorized route keys, CAS by If-Match, idempotent by Idempotency-Key.
writeContract.recents: At most 20 unique authorized route keys, server-timed LRU, 30-day TTL, idempotent by Idempotency-Key.
writeContract.receiptStore: Use the G2 canonical shared sys_hris_command_receipts table; do not introduce an explorer-only receipt store.
writeContract.receiptReconciliation: Use the exact explorer-originating profile on SYS-API-038 for RESULT_UNKNOWN and terminal receipt reads; do not infer success from a retry.

activityProjection.providerRule: Owner modules expose authorization-filtered typed metadata through XCON-012..015 adapters. Platform composes providers and does not query another service database.
activityProjection.emptyRule: An empty list is valid only when all registered providers returned successfully and no authorized active item exists; missing or failed providers must produce PARTIAL status, not a false empty success.

persistence.isolation: Verified tenant and authenticated principal are server-bound on every read and write; RLS is enabled and forced.
persistence.cleanup: READ_AND_WRITE_THROUGH_PURGE of retired, denied, expired or unknown route keys in the same transaction.
persistence.crossDatabaseRule: No service-to-service database query or foreign key is allowed.

activation.rule: Implementation and tests do not authorize bundle activation or tenant rollout.
